note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors. Nominations were received by Mr. James L. Clark on 6 May 1936. Twenty-two divisions were filled unopposed; no nominations were received for Ballinadrenta and Connor, whose retiring members held their seats. Filed on 1936-06-04, the polling day for county council and rural district elections in Co. Antrim that year (confirmed); previously filed under 1936-05-28 (verification 5 Nov 2026). Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Cargan' to Cargin (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the 1911 DED map (Antrim Rural District) and the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1921-69 name the DED Cargin; the rounds were filed as Cargin (1927, 1930, 1946, 1958, 1961, 1964); Cargan (1933, 1936, 1939). This round was filed as 'Cargan', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (cargan) answers with a redirect to this one.
